cefrAlignment: Matches B1 (CEFR CV: can understand the main points of short recorded messages and simple technical information, and note specific details such as numbers and names): voicemails of 70–130 words with clear structure, one self-correction and spelled names.
examFidelity: Accurately reflects TOEIC Part 4 voicemail questions (who, why, request; three questions per talk per exams.ts); the message-completion task uses IELTS-style ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER and all accepted answers respect it; phone numbers use fictional ranges (555-01xx, 07700 900xxx).
openConcerns: TTS should be checked for 'oh seven seven double oh, nine double oh, four one eight' being read as digits with natural grouping.
learnerOutcome: A learner who completes the lesson can identify the caller, purpose and request in a voicemail, note a name, time, price and phone number accurately, and pick the right option in a recorded phone menu.
